geometry.method: Source isolated and updated before measuring. All positions, evaluated face topology, UVs and cut-plane intersection points compared exactly; normal-only changes.
geometry.boundaryProfileJoin: Adjacent exact source profiles reconstruct full posts; shader colors are a common world-Z ramp, invariant under translation in XY and cardinal rotation. Curved side endpoint normals are radial and identical across both profile halves.
geometry.normals: Half-post radial curved sides; tops/bottoms/cut faces planar. Rope weighted normals; original bevel shape unchanged.
